To, All Authorised Dealer Category-I banks and other Authorised Persons

answer.action: Submit compounding applications for overseas investments, borrowing, lending, and guarantees to the designated Regional Offices of the Reserve Bank instead of the Central Office.
answer.action_quote: the powers to compound contraventions related to Overseas Investments and Borrowing and Lending, and Guarantees transactions have also been delegated to the select Regional Offices of the Reserve Bank
answer.amends: Master Directions on Compounding of Contraventions under FEMA, 1999
